description: Machine-readable registry of Wraith contract deployments and network configuration. This is the single source of truth for contract addresses, RPC endpoints, and network metadata. Docs pages must not duplicate contract addresses; they reference this manifest instead.

fieldTypes.immutable: Value never changes after the network record is created (e.g. network passphrase). Safe to hard-code.
fieldTypes.external: Value is owned and operated by a third party (SDF, an RPC provider, a subgraph host). Wraith does not control it and it can change without notice.
fieldTypes.pending: Value is not yet deployed or determined. Do not use in production. Track readiness in contracts/stellar/MAINNET_READINESS.md.
fieldTypes.null: Field is absent or not applicable for this network (e.g. Friendbot on mainnet, Horizon on Futurenet). Treat as undefined in code.

networks.resetCadence: ~quarterly — SDF-operated reset wipes all accounts, balances, and contract state

trustBoundary.control: SDF operates Horizon, Soroban RPC, and Friendbot. Testnet resets are initiated by SDF without Wraith involvement.
trustBoundary.warning: Do not hold real value. All state is wiped on reset.

provenance.method: On-chain contract inspection via Soroban RPC, cross-checked against SDK TypeScript bindings

trustBoundary.control: SDF operates RPC and Friendbot. Resets can occur at any time and run non-production protocol versions.
trustBoundary.warning: Do not use for integration testing. State can be wiped at any time.
